title: Ghostline
summary: Pay-per-call channels for AI agents using cumulative off-chain vouchers and one settlement. November 4 review of the public demo observed five simulated calls and an overspend rejection; the refreshed recording shows only that walletless browser flow. Its displayed transaction is separately labeled creator evidence. The creator updated the original submission on November 3 after the Esmeralda reset, replacing retired October transaction links with a new template and recorded Sapient run. The site evidence page lists a separate November 3 run; call counts are service-ledger claims, not chain proof. Optional live mode requires Sapient 0.7.1 or later and a custodial relay that holds a 51 µT test deposit through settlement or refund. Fees, timing and requests remain visible. No wallet action, relay deposit, CLI execution or independent chain validation was performed in this review. The v0.4.0 CLI binaries support Linux x86-64 with glibc. Earlier recordings and transaction URLs remain in the maintenance history.
cardSummary: Explore payment channels that let AI agents pay per API call using cumulative vouchers and one settlement.
